metadata.title: oneground
metadata.description: Open-source playground and evaluation toolkit for testing, comparing, and benchmarking decision models before integration.

header.title: System One Playground
header.subtitle: Send typed questions (noul, choice, score) over a state and visualize the judgments.

model.label: Model
model.limit: You can select up to {max} models.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure any TypeSafe-compatible System One endpoint.
settings.apiUrlHint: Enter the API base URL, /v1 URL, or full /v1/systemone endpoint. Default: {url}
settings.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted in the database. Leave blank to keep the saved key; use Clear key to remove it.

state.title: State
state.description: Text or JSON. JSON is parsed and sent as structured state; reference fields with backticked paths in instructions.

bulk.description: Many states, the same questions. Split states by the delimiter; each piece is parsed like a single state. JSONL parses each line as JSON. Pasting from Excel works with Tab.
bulk.limit: Bulk mode allows at most {max} states (parsed {count}).

questions.label: Questions
questions.description: Evaluated in parallel against the same state, each answered independently.
questions.empty: No questions yet. Add a noul, choice, or score.

noul.label: Noul
noul.description: Yes/no judgment over the state, answered as a probability between 0 and 1.

choice.label: Choice
choice.description: Pick the best option from a list of keys, each with an optional rubric description.

score.label: Score
score.description: Rate the state against an ordered rubric of levels (2–10), answered as a level index.

toasts.invalidUrl: API URL is not a valid URL.

code.liveEmpty: Fill in state and at least one question to preview the request.
code.noModel: Pick a model to preview the request.
code.bulkNote: Bulk mode sends one request per state — showing the first state.

answers.empty: Run an evaluation to see answers, probability distributions, and confidence.
answers.requestEmpty: Run an evaluation to see the request payload.
answers.responseEmpty: Run an evaluation to see the raw response.
answers.noulDescription: Probability the answer is yes. Noul has no separate confidence.
answers.scored: Scored {score} on a 0–{max} scale (can land between levels).

evalLab.title: Evaluation Lab
evalLab.subtitle: Pick a question profile, upload a labeled dataset (JSON, JSONL, CSV, TSV, XML, Excel), match the columns, then run the first rows on multiple models to compare accuracy.
evalLab.datasetDescription: Drop a dataset file or enter data manually. CSV/TSV need a header row; JSON needs an array of objects; JSONL one object per line; XML needs repeating row/record/item elements; Excel reads the first sheet with data.
evalLab.dropTitle: Drag & drop a dataset file here
evalLab.dropHint: or click to browse — XLSX, JSON, JSONL, CSV, TSV, XML
evalLab.samplesLabel: Download an example with your question columns:
evalLab.valuesInfoTitle: What goes in the label columns?
evalLab.valuesInfoCols: Columns: id, state, plus one column per question id.
evalLab.valuesInfoNoul: noul (yes/no): write true or false — not 1 or 0.
evalLab.valuesInfoChoice: choice: write the option key from the question profile (e.g. technical).
evalLab.valuesInfoScore: score: write the 0-based level number (first level is 0).
evalLab.valuesInfoBlank: Leave a cell blank to skip scoring that question on that row.
evalLab.excelHint: Excel reads the first sheet with data; the first row must hold column headers. Other sheets are ignored.
evalLab.excelNotReady: Excel file is still loading. Wait a moment and retry.
evalLab.previewDescription: First {shown} of {count} rows. Check the columns, then continue.
evalLab.qprofileDescription: Load a saved profile or define the questions manually. Profiles are shared with the Playground.
evalLab.trimmed: Only the first {max} rows run per evaluation.
evalLab.tooMany: Dataset has {count} rows; limit is {max}. Trim it before parsing.
evalLab.mappingDescription: Define what each model must judge, then point each question at the column/property holding its correct answer. The state column is the model input; expected-answer columns stay out of the input.
evalLab.stateHint: Text or JSON the model reads. Reference nested values with dotted paths like ticket.text.
evalLab.runDescription: The same rows and questions run on every selected model. Accuracy counts exact matches against your expected answers.
evalLab.needMapping: Map at least one question to an expected-answer column.
